title: Delivery plan of Stage 7, Progressive Delivery (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/delivery.json, not committed)
description: Protocol §5, Stage 7. The binary does not deploy: from intent.delivery and the verdict, it builds the plan that the platform executes, and the run is tied to it (verify-run checks it by hash). Feature flag + canary rings (1 % → 10 % → 100 % by default), Rollback Sentinel over telemetry (error_rate_delta, latency_p99 and the slice's invariants, the expensive ones by periodic reconciliation), and CB-06: a slice with writes and no compensation strategy does not go past the 1 % ring (max_ring 1, blocked_by CB-06). In refactor, legacy/new parity only on read-only paths; on write paths, canary with compensation.

candidate.description: The commit to deploy: that of Stage 3 (the one selected with N=2), or null if the run judged the working tree.

feature_flag.description: Name of the flag that enables the slice per ring: a2dlc.<slice_id>.

requires.description: What must be green in the previous ring to open this one: sentinel_green always; compensation_declared in every ring above 1 % when the slice writes; reconciliation_green at 100 % when there are invariants.

max_ring.description: How far up the rings the slice can go with what is declared. 100 if nothing stops it; 1 with writes without compensation (CB-06).

reconciliation.description: The invariants are asserted at runtime per request where possible; periodic when there are invariants: the expensive ones (global conservation) are also verified by the platform through periodic reconciliation, not per request. none without invariants.

paths.description: Globs of the read-only paths the parity runs on (intent.delivery.read_only_paths).

parity.description: Only in refactor: dual legacy/new execution in the Scientist style on read-only paths; null in the other modes.

canary.description: Globs of the paths that get a canary with compensation: the write paths of the slice.
